title: Classes, Objects, Interfaces, and Composition Quick Check

questions.prompt: Where should a rule required for every Expense instance normally be enforced?
questions.explanation: Protecting the invariant during construction prevents invalid instances from travelling through the program.

questions.prompt: Select the sound reasons to introduce an interface.
questions.explanation: Interfaces model capabilities and variation; creating one mechanically for every class adds needless abstraction.

questions.answer: An object receives or owns focused collaborators and delegates parts of its work to them
questions.explanation: Composition assembles behaviour from explicit collaborators without claiming an inheritance relationship.
